answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, and tie its reputation to that stake rather than to a free username. A hollow identity with no stake and no work history earns no trust, while a whisper of activity from a new account cannot move prices or votes. If the agent cheats, the delta between its promised and delivered work triggers slashing, so creating thousands of fake agents costs thousands of stakes and the attacker loses money faster than honest agents earn it.
